import sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import t_perf2
from common import validate

src=open('/workspace/submission/planning.py').read()
src=src.replace("from protocols import probe_script","probe_script=__import__('protocols').probe_script")
src=src.replace("        if distance[sink]==INFINITY:\n            break",
"""        if distance[sink]==INFINITY:
            break
        if 'POT' in globals():
            POT.append(potential[:])""")
src=src.replace("""    for position in live_offers:
        node=allocate()
        merged[position].append(node)""",
"""    for position in live_offers:
        node=allocate()
        merged[position].append(node)
        if 'OFFERCOST' in globals():
            OFFERCOST.append((node,merged[position][1]))""")
ns={}
exec(compile(src,'p','exec'),ns)
ns['POT']=[]; ns['OFFERCOST']=[]
job=t_perf2.build(7,nreq=64,noffer=128,pairs=4096)
ctx=validate(job)
res=ns['solve'](ctx,{r['id']:True for r in job['requests']})
POT=ns['POT']; OC=dict(ns['OFFERCOST'])
print('offers',len(OC),'phases',len(POT))
for phase in (1,2,10,63):
    pot=POT[phase]
    zeros=sum(1 for node,c in OC.items() if c-pot[node]==0)
    pos=sum(1 for node,c in OC.items() if c-pot[node]>0)
    neg=sum(1 for node,c in OC.items() if c-pot[node]<0)
    print('phase',phase,'phi==0:',zeros,'phi>0:',pos,'phi<0:',neg,
          'sample',[(c,pot[n]) for n,c in list(OC.items())[:5]])
PYEOF
